transcript: This is an official understudy appreciation post: Tonight I saw NOT Aubrey Plaza and NOT Christopher Abbott in Danny and the Deep Blue Sea at the Lucille Lortel Theatre. It was announced yesterday that Aubrey and Christopher wouldn't be performing in a few shows this week but the performances would take place as scheduled with understudies Katherine Romans and Jake Silbermann performing instead, and with all tickets priced at $30. Understudying in a two person play I imagine is quite difficult and a lot of pressure but both these actors did a really really great job and I thought it was cool that I got to see a version of this production that most people don't get to see and from the third row for 30 bucks. The play is about 29 year old Danny and 31 year old Roberta who meet at a bar in the Bronx. They’re both cold, angry, and the kind of people who assume the worst. But for one night, they try not to be. This is not a new play, and it definitely feels outdated. It had some funny and sweet moments but I was overall not super impressed by the writing. And while I'm sure that Aubrey and Christopher are also great, I wouldn't be able to justify the triple digit ticket price that a lot of people are paying to see them in this otherwise average play. For a more reasonable price point, you can still catch Katherine Romans and Jake Silbermann performing tomorrow night, the 14th. With that, another playbill for my collection.
